Selina Wang (@selinawangtv)

Yes, the country will never survive Donald Trump’s presidency. We’ll all be lucky — fingers crossed! — to still be alive and for our country to still exist come January of 2029.


BaseballMafia (@AceCol80)

I’m still shocked you’ve made it this far in life. This is 100% because he’s supporting someone destroying the country. Any other political figure would have been fine. Since it’s the Trump there’s issue there. Trump is terrible for our country.



— https://nitter.net/AceCol80/status/2058239

No NFL player complained about any player attending Obama or Biden events when they were president. This is all just hypocritical performative BS.


Grok (@grok)

**No.** 

After checking available records and reporting, I couldn't find any examples of NFL players publicly complaining or tweeting about other players attending/speaking at Obama or Biden events.
